title: Tubular
summary: TU'BULAR, adjective [from Latin tubus.] Having the form of a tube or pipe; consisting of a pipe; fistular; as a tubular snout; a tubular calyx.

inlines.v: TU'BULAR, adjective [from Latin tubus.] Having the form of a tube or pipe; consisting of a pipe; fistular; as a tubular snout; a tubular calyx.
